   317	            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
   318	            reconstructed, quant_loss, _, _ = model(batch)
   319	            # === DDP 包装下, 通过 .module 调 compute_loss (避免 DDP all_reduce 干扰) ===
   320	            loss, recon_loss = raw_module.compute_loss(batch, reconstructed, quant_loss)
   321	            occ_loss = raw_module.prefix_occupancy_loss(
   322	                batch, batch_occ_w.to(device), batch_transition_w.to(device),
   323	                behaviour_on=BEHAVIOUR_ON, geometry_on=GEOMETRY_ON,
   324	            )
   325	            loss = loss + OCC_WEIGHT * occ_loss
   326	            if not torch.isfinite(loss):
   327	                raise RuntimeError(f"RQ-VAE loss became non-finite at epoch {epoch}")
   328	            loss.backward()
   329	            if GRADIENT_CLIP_NORM > 0:
   330	                torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), GRADIENT_CLIP_NORM)
   331	            optimizer.step()
   332	            scheduler.step()
   333	            losses.append(float(loss.detach()))
   334	            recons.append(float(recon_loss.detach()))
   335	        epoch_time_s = round(time.time() - _epoch_t0, 3)
   336	
   337	        # === DDP all_reduce: 跨 rank 求平均 loss / recon ===
   338	        local_loss = torch.tensor(float(np.mean(losses)) if losses else 0.0, device=device)
   339	        local_recon = torch.tensor(float(np.mean(recons)) if recons else 0.0, device=device)
   340	        if world_size > 1:
   341	            dist.all_reduce(local_loss, op=dist.ReduceOp.SUM)
   342	            dist.all_reduce(local_recon, op=dist.ReduceOp.SUM)
   343	        avg_loss = float(local_loss.item()) / max(world_size, 1)
   344	        avg_recon = float(local_recon.item()) / max(world_size, 1)
   345	        cur_lr = optimizer.param_groups[0]["lr"]
   346	
   347	        # === 非 eval 间隔: 只 log train 行 ===
   348	        if epoch % EVAL_INTERVAL != 0 and epoch != EPOCHS:
   349	            if rank == 0:
   350	                print(f"[RQ-VAE] epoch={epoch} loss={avg_loss:.8f} recon={avg_recon:.8f} lr={cur_lr:.3e} time={epoch_time_s}s", flush=True)
   351	                _record(rank, "train", epoch=epoch, loss=avg_loss, recon=avg_recon, lr=cur_lr, epoch_time_s=epoch_time_s, cumulative_time_s=round(time.time() - _T0, 3))
   352	            continue
   353	
   354	        # === eval 间隔: only rank 0 跑 (避免 4 卡 N× 全集评估) ===
   355	        model.eval()
   356	        # Skip DDP all_reduce inside VQLayer.forward when rank 0 runs eval alone:
   357	        # rank 1-3 are stuck in barrier and won't join, would deadlock.
   358	        for layer in raw_module.rq.vq_layers:
   359	            layer._skip_ddp_reduce = True
   360	        raw_unique = None
   361	        collision_v = None
   362	        try:
   363	            if rank == 0:
   364	                with torch.no_grad():
   365	                    raw_tokens = raw_module.get_indices(
   366	                        all_embeddings.to(device), infer_use_sk=False
   367	                    ).cpu().numpy().astype(np.int64)
   368	                raw_unique = int(len(np.unique(raw_tokens, axis=0)))
   369	                collision_v = 1.0 - raw_unique / len(raw_tokens)
   370	                final_collision = collision_v
   371	                final_raw_unique = raw_unique
   372	                print(
   373	                    f"[RQ-VAE] epoch={epoch} loss={avg_loss:.8f} recon={avg_recon:.8f} "
   374	                    f"lr={cur_lr:.3e} raw_unique={raw_unique}/{len(raw_tokens)} "
   375	                    f"collision={collision_v:.6f} time={epoch_time_s}s",
   376	                    flush=True,
   377	                )
   378	                _record(
   379	                    rank, "train", epoch=epoch, loss=avg_loss, recon=avg_recon, lr=cur_lr,
   380	                    epoch_time_s=epoch_time_s,
   381	                    cumulative_time_s=round(time.time() - _T0, 3),
   382	                    raw_unique=raw_unique, raw_total=len(raw_tokens), collision=collision_v,
   383	                )
   384	        finally:
   385	            for layer in raw_module.rq.vq_layers:
   386	                layer._skip_ddp_reduce = False
   387	        if world_size > 1:
   388	            dist.barrier()
   389	
   390	    # === 训练结束: only rank 0 保存终点 checkpoint 并导出 SID ===
   391	    # Stage3 只接受训练终点权重；不保留任何中间或"最优 collision"快照。
   392	    if rank == 0:
   393	        final_state = {
   394	            name: value.detach().cpu().clone()
   395	            for name, value in raw_module.state_dict().items()
   396	        }
   397	        CHECKPOINT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   398	        torch.save(
   399	            {
   400	                "state_dict": final_state,
   401	                "epoch": EPOCHS,
   402	                "collision": final_collision,
   403	                "selection": "final_epoch",
   404	            },
   405	            CHECKPOINT,
   406	        )
   407	        _record(
   408	            rank, "ckpt_saved", epoch=EPOCHS, path=str(CHECKPOINT),
   409	            reason="final_epoch", collision=final_collision,
   410	            raw_unique=final_raw_unique,
   411	        )
   412	        raw_module.eval()
   413	        # Skip DDP all_reduce inside VQLayer.forward during the export
   414	        # inference pass — rank 1-3 are stuck in barrier, would deadlock.
   415	        for layer in raw_module.rq.vq_layers:
   416	            layer._skip_ddp_reduce = True
   417	        try:
   418	            with torch.no_grad():
   419	                raw_tokens = raw_module.get_indices(
   420	                    all_embeddings.to(device), infer_use_sk=False
   421	                ).cpu().numpy().astype(np.int64)
   422	        finally:
   423	            for layer in raw_module.rq.vq_layers:
   424	                layer._skip_ddp_reduce = False
   425	        sid = _extend_collisions(raw_tokens, codebook_sizes)
   426	        if len(np.unique(sid, axis=0)) != len(sid):
   427	            raise RuntimeError("RecBole SID extension failed to make item codes unique")
   428	        OUTPUT_SID.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   429	        np.save(OUTPUT_SID, sid)
   430	        payload = {str(item_id): [int(value) for value in row] for item_id, row in enumerate(sid)}
   431	        OUTPUT_JSON.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
   432	        print(f"[RecBole RQ-VAE] exported raw_shape={raw_tokens.shape} sid_shape={sid.shape} unique={len(np.unique(sid, axis=0))} -> {OUTPUT_SID}", flush=True)
   433	        _record(rank, "train_end", total_wall_time_s=round(time.time() - _T0, 3), final_collision=final_collision, checkpoint_selection="final_epoch", sid_shape=list(sid.shape), output_sid=str(OUTPUT_SID), output_json=str(OUTPUT_JSON), unique_after_extend=len(np.unique(sid, axis=0)))
   434	
   435	    if world_size > 1:
   436	        dist.barrier()
   437	        dist.destroy_process_group()
   438	
   439	
   440	def _launch_via_torchrun() -> None:
   441	    """2026-09-22: 与 stage3 同款, 但不同端口 (50202). 顶层调用时自动 fork 4 卡 DDP."""
   442	    if int(os.environ.get("RANK", -1)) >= 0:
   443	        return  # 已经在 torchrun 启动的子进程里
   444	    if os.environ.get(SINGLE_GPU_ENV) == "1":
   445	        return
   446	    LOG_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   447	    env = dict(os.environ)
   448	    env["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = _LAUNCHER["visible_dev"]
   449	    env["NCCL_IB_DISABLE"]     = "1"
   450	    env["NCCL_P2P_DISABLE"]    = "1"
   451	    env["NCCL_SHM_DISABLE"]    = "1"
   452	    env["NCCL_TIMEOUT"]        = "3600"
   453	    env["TORCH_NCCL_BLOCKING_WAIT"] = "1"
   454	    cmd = [
   455	        _LAUNCHER["torchrun"],
   456	        "--standalone",
   457	        f"--nproc_per_node={_LAUNCHER['nproc']}",
   458	        f"--master_port={_LAUNCHER['master_port']}",
   459	        _LAUNCHER["script"],
   460	    ]
   461	    with open(_LAUNCHER["log"], "w", encoding="utf-8") as fout:
   462	        rc = subprocess.call(cmd, stdout=fout, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, env=env)
   463	    sys.exit(rc)
   464	
   465	
   466	if __name__ == "__main__":
   467	    _launch_via_torchrun()
   468	    main()

    40	# === 硬编码路径常量 (CLAUDE.md §1) ===

    98	# === 2026-09-22: 全程训练 metrics JSONL 收集器 (rank 0 only) ===
    99	_metrics_lock = threading.Lock()
   100	_T0 = time.time()
   101	# Truncate-on-train_start: every fresh run starts with an empty metrics file
   102	# so a single ``training_metrics.jsonl`` always represents exactly one run
   103	# (no leftover rows from a prior failed attempt).
   104	_metrics_truncated = False
   105	def _record(rank, event, **fields):
   106	    if rank != 0:
   107	        return
   108	    rec = {"event": event, "timestamp": time.time(), "wall_time_s": round(time.time() - _T0, 3)}
   109	    rec.update(fields)

   114	        # file scoped to this run while still letting multiple ``_record``
   115	        # calls in the same epoch run in append mode (cheap).
   116	        if not _metrics_truncated:
   117	            open(METRICS_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8").close()

   127	
   128	def set_seed(seed: int) -> None:
   129	    random.seed(seed)
   130	    np.random.seed(seed)
   131	    torch.manual_seed(seed)
   132	    if torch.cuda.is_available():
   133	        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
   134	    torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True
   135	    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = False
   136	    torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True, warn_only=True)
   137	    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("high")

   139	
   140	def load_embeddings(path: Path) -> np.ndarray:
   141	    """Load an (N, D) item-embedding matrix.
   142	
   143	    Accepts either:
   144	    - a Parquet frame with an ``embedding`` column of per-row arrays
   145	      (the historical RecBole3.0 ``item_emb.parquet`` convention), or
   146	    - an ``*.npy`` file containing an ``(N, D)`` ``float32`` array
   147	      (stage1's ``sentence_t5.npy`` output).
   148	    """
   149	    suffix = path.suffix.lower()
   150	    if suffix == ".npy":
   151	        embeddings = np.asarray(np.load(path), dtype="float32")
   152	    elif suffix in {".parquet", ".pq"}:
   153	        frame = pd.read_parquet(path)
   154	        if "embedding" not in frame:
   155	            raise ValueError(f"Embedding file must contain an embedding column: {path}")
   156	        embeddings = np.stack(frame["embedding"].to_numpy()).astype("float32", copy=False)
   157	    else:
   158	        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported embedding file suffix: {path}")
   159	    if embeddings.ndim != 2 or not np.isfinite(embeddings).all():
   160	        raise ValueError(f"Invalid embedding matrix: shape={embeddings.shape}")
   161	    return embeddings
   162	
   163	
   164	def maybe_apply_pca(embeddings: np.ndarray, pca_dim: int, seed: int) -> np.ndarray:
   165	    if pca_dim <= 0:
   166	        return embeddings
   167	    if pca_dim >= embeddings.shape[1]:
   168	        raise ValueError(f"--pca_dim must be smaller than input dimension {embeddings.shape[1]}")
   169	    from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
   170	
   171	    reduced = PCA(n_components=pca_dim, whiten=True, random_state=seed).fit_transform(embeddings)
   172	    return reduced.astype("float32", copy=False)
   173	
   174	
   175	def initialize_tiger_weights(model: RQVAE) -> None:
   176	    for module in model.modules():
   177	        if isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
   178	            nn.init.xavier_normal_(module.weight)
   179	            if module.bias is not None:
   180	                nn.init.zeros_(module.bias)
   181	
   182	
   183	def _extend_collisions(tokens: np.ndarray, codebook_sizes: list[int]) -> np.ndarray:
   184	    """Match RecBole3.0's extend path with one fixed extra SID level."""
   185	    if tokens.ndim != 2 or tokens.shape[1] != len(codebook_sizes):
   186	        raise ValueError(f"Token shape {tokens.shape} disagrees with codebook sizes {codebook_sizes}")
   187	    groups: dict[tuple[int, ...], list[int]] = {}
   188	    for item_id, row in enumerate(tokens.tolist()):
   189	        groups.setdefault(tuple(int(value) for value in row), []).append(item_id)
   190	    offsets = np.cumsum([0, *codebook_sizes], dtype=np.int64)
   191	    result = np.empty((len(tokens), tokens.shape[1] + 1), dtype=np.int64)
   192	    for row, item_ids in groups.items():
   193	        for occurrence, item_id in enumerate(item_ids):
   194	            result[item_id, :-1] = np.asarray(row, dtype=np.int64)
   195	            result[item_id, -1] = int(offsets[-1] + occurrence)
   196	    return result
   197	
   198	
   199	def _tokenizer_config() -> SimpleNamespace:
   200	    sizes = list(CODEBOOK_SIZE)
   201	    if len(sizes) == 1:
   202	        sizes *= CODEBOOK_NUM
   203	    if len(sizes) != CODEBOOK_NUM:
   204	        raise ValueError("CODEBOOK_SIZE must contain one size or one size per codebook level")
   205	    return SimpleNamespace(
   206	        hidden_sizes=HIDDEN_SIZES,
   207	        codebook_num=CODEBOOK_NUM,
   208	        codebook_size=tuple(sizes),
   209	        codebook_dim=CODEBOOK_DIM,
   210	        dropout=0.0,
   211	        beta=BETA,
   212	        vq_type=VQ_TYPE,
   213	        ema_decay=EMA_DECAY,
   214	        fix_code_embs=False,
   215	        sk_epsilon=SK_EPSILON,
   216	        sk_iters=SK_ITERS,
   217	    )

   219	
   220	def main() -> None:
   221	    # === DDP 初始化 ===
   222	    if "RANK" in os.environ and int(os.environ.get("RANK", -1)) >= 0:
   223	        dist.init_process_group(backend="nccl")
   224	        rank = dist.get_rank()
   225	        world_size = dist.get_world_size()
   226	        local_rank = int(os.environ.get("LOCAL_RANK", rank))
   227	        torch.cuda.set_device(local_rank)
   228	        device = torch.device(f"cuda:{local_rank}")
   229	    else:
   230	        rank, world_size, local_rank = 0, 1, 0
   231	        device = torch.device("cuda:0" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
   232	
   233	    set_seed(SEED + rank)
   234	    embeddings = maybe_apply_pca(load_embeddings(EMBEDDING_FILE), PCA_DIM, SEED)
   235	    train_frame = pd.read_parquet(TRAIN_FILE)
   236	    train_ids = np.unique(train_frame["target"].to_numpy(dtype=np.int64))
   237	    if train_ids.size == 0 or train_ids.min() < 0 or train_ids.max() >= len(embeddings):
   238	        raise ValueError("Training target item ids do not match the embedding rows")
   239	
   240	    all_embeddings = torch.from_numpy(embeddings)
   241	    train_embeddings = all_embeddings[torch.from_numpy(train_ids)]
   242	    config = _tokenizer_config()
   243	    model = RQVAE(config, in_dim=embeddings.shape[1]).to(device)
   244	    if XAVIER_INIT:
   245	        initialize_tiger_weights(model)
   246	    if world_size > 1:
   247	        model = DDP(model, device_ids=[local_rank], output_device=local_rank, find_unused_parameters=False)
   248	
   249	    # Directed training transitions from each history's last item to target.
   250	    src_count = np.ones(len(embeddings), dtype=np.float32)
   251	    dst_count = np.zeros(len(embeddings), dtype=np.float32)
   252	    for row in train_frame.itertuples(index=False):
   253	        target = int(row.target)
   254	        hist = np.asarray(row.history, dtype=np.int64)
   255	        if hist.size:
   256	            src_count[int(hist[-1])] += 1.0
   257	            dst_count[target] += 1.0
   258	    occupancy_w = torch.from_numpy(np.log1p(dst_count[train_ids]).astype(np.float32) + 1.0)
   259	    transition_w = torch.from_numpy(np.log1p(src_count[train_ids]).astype(np.float32) + 1.0)
   260	    train_dataset = TensorDataset(train_embeddings, occupancy_w, transition_w)
   261	    train_sampler = DistributedSampler(train_dataset, num_replicas=world_size, rank=rank, shuffle=True, seed=SEED, drop_last=False) if world_size > 1 else None
   262	    loader = DataLoader(
   263	        train_dataset,
   264	        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE_PER_RANK,
   265	        shuffle=(train_sampler is None),
   266	        sampler=train_sampler,
   267	        num_workers=NUM_WORKERS,
   268	        pin_memory=device.type == "cuda",
   269	        persistent_workers=False,  # 2026-09-24: 关闭避免每个 epoch 都 fork 一次
   270	    )
   271	
   272	    if OPTIMIZER.lower() == "adagrad":
   273	        optimizer = torch.optim.Adagrad(model.parameters(), lr=LR, weight_decay=WEIGHT_DECAY)

    14	def _lorentz_distance(x: torch.Tensor, y: torch.Tensor, curvature: float = 1.0) -> torch.Tensor:

    21	    a, b = lift(x), lift(y)
    22	    minkowski = -a[..., :1] * b[..., :1] + (a[..., 1:] * b[..., 1:]).sum(-1, keepdim=True)
    23	    return torch.acosh((-curvature * minkowski).clamp_min(1.0 + 1e-6)).squeeze(-1) / sq
